name: @office/domain-contracts
description: Office contracts/change domain module (OFF-012): the canonical contracts and change model — the project-scoped Contract aggregate (parties as typed person/company links, canonical minor-unit contract value, forward-only execution status, explicit one-way archive) owning its immutable scope obligations, the ChangeEvent aggregate binding change to scope/evidence/cost/schedule through TYPED cross-entity links (ids and refs only — never copied data, immutable once recorded), the ChangeOrder lifecycle (submitted -> approved/rejected -> executed, executing supersedes the originating change event's proposed state, rejected orders never mutate scope), and immutable claim references binding claims to evidence + change orders. Pure domain: no SQL, no migrations, no repository layer — deterministic, in-memory-testable, injected clock/id suppliers. Depends only on @office/contracts, @office/domain-kernel, @office/authz, @office/events (the thin ledger-backed EventSink adapter) and @office/persistence (the SqlExecutor type of the mirrored EventSink port).
